doc.name: entscheidsuche
doc.instructions: MCP-Server für entscheidsuche.ch — eine Suchmaschine für Schweizer Gerichtsentscheide, Gerichtsurteile, Rechtsprechung und Swiss case law. Die Tools helfen bei Entscheiden des Bundesgerichts (BGer, BGE) sowie kantonalen Gerichten, Obergerichten, Verwaltungsgerichten und weiteren Schweizer Gerichten. Unterstützt Volltextsuche, Geschäftsnummern- bzw. Urteilsnummern-Suche, Volltext-Abruf einzelner Entscheide, Hierarchien für Kantone und Gerichte sowie Facetten für Filter und Recherche.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search decisions
tools.description:
Full-text search across Swiss court judgments, court decisions and case law from entscheidsuche.ch. Covers decisions of the Federal Supreme Court (BGer, BGE) and cantonal courts such as Kantonsgericht, Obergericht or Verwaltungsgericht.

Typical use cases:
  - Search Federal Supreme Court judgments, BGE or rulings by topic
  - Find Swiss case law on tenancy law, ZGB, OR, StGB or BV
  - Verify case numbers, judgment numbers or citations
  - Related tools: fetch_document, search_by_case_number, list_hierarchy, list_facets

Search syntax (Lucene query string):
  - Phrase / case-number search: "BGE 142 III 1" (in quotes)
  - Boolean operators: AND, OR, NOT (or +, -)
  - Wildcards: * and ?
  - The default operator between terms is AND.

Filters are combined with AND. Use hierarchy IDs from `list_hierarchy` or `list_facets`.

Pagination: after the first call, pass the `next_cursor` value from the response as `search_after` in the next call.

query.description: Full-text query. "..." for phrases, AND/OR/NOT for Boolean operators, * and ? for wildcards. "*" matches everything.
query.title: Query

language.description: Optional preferred language for highlighting/display (de, fr, it). If omitted, the first available language field is returned — this does NOT filter; use `language_filter` for that.

sort.description: Optional sort order: 'relevance' | 'date' (decision date) | 'scrapedate'. Default is 'relevance'.
sort.title: Sort

search_after.description: Cursor from `next_cursor` of the previous response.
search_after.title: Search After

decision_date_from.description: Lower bound for the decision date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).
decision_date_from.title: Decision Date From

decision_date_to.description: Upper bound for the decision date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).
decision_date_to.title: Decision Date To

scrape_date_from.description: Lower bound for the scrape date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).
scrape_date_from.title: Scrape Date From

scrape_date_to.description: Upper bound for the scrape date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).
scrape_date_to.title: Scrape Date To

hierarchy.description: List of hierarchy IDs (canton/court/chamber). Multiple IDs are combined with OR; with other filters, AND.
hierarchy.title: Hierarchy

text.description: Highlight excerpt from the full text.
text.title: Text

document_url.description: Direct download link to the original document.
document_url.title: Document Url

original_url.description: URL of the original source web page.
original_url.title: Original Url

content_length.description: Length of the indexed full text in characters. Only set by `fetch_document`.
content_length.title: Content Length

text_truncated.description: True if the indexed full text was truncated by Elasticsearch at 100,000 characters. In that case `text` contains only the beginning of the decision; the complete document is available at `document_url`.
text_truncated.title: Text Truncated

sort.description: Sort values of the hit (for search_after).
sort.title: Sort

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass it again as `search_after` in the next request. None if there are no further results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

tools.name: search_by_case_number
tools.title: Search by case number
tools.description: Specialized search for case numbers, judgment numbers and BGE citations in Swiss court judgments. This tool automatically wraps the given case number in quotes and runs an exact phrase search, for example for 'BGE 142 III 1', '5A_396/2015' or similar references from the Federal Supreme Court (BGer, BGE) and cantonal case law.

tools.name: fetch_document
tools.title: Fetch decision
tools.description: Fetch a single Swiss court decision, judgment or Federal Supreme Court decision by its document ID (`_id`). Returns the indexed full text of the decision together with metadata, title, abstract and links. Use this when the full decision should be read or processed after a search. Note: for very long decisions the indexed text is capped at 100,000 characters; if `text_truncated` is true, the complete document is available at `document_url`.

language.description: Optional preferred language for title/abstract. If omitted, the first available language field is returned.

tools.name: list_hierarchy
tools.title: List hierarchy buckets
tools.description: Returns the available hierarchy IDs for Swiss cantons, courts and chambers together with document counts. Useful for narrowing subsequent searches to the Federal Supreme Court, cantonal courts, Obergerichte or Verwaltungsgerichte.

tools.title: Facet tree (localized)
tools.description: Hierarchical facet tree with localized labels for cantons, courts and chambers. The `id` fields can be used in the `hierarchy` filter of the search.
